_readme: All lists are substring matches, case-insensitive. Edit and restart the MCP server.
deny_processes / deny_window_titles  -> hard refusal, no override possible
approval_processes / approval_window_titles -> every action needs a human click
allow_processes (non-empty) -> only these processes may be touched at all
_deny_comment: Hard refusal. Password managers, crypto wallets, and tools that can destroy the system.
_deny_titles_comment: Hard refusal by window title. Catches web pages and apps whose process name is generic (a browser tab showing a bank).
_approval_comment: Not refused, but every click/keystroke here pops the approval dialog. Use this for apps where a stray action is irreversible (send) or reaches another machine.
_allow_comment: Non-empty switches to allow-list mode: only these processes may be operated at all.
